title: Dialogue auto-advance
hypothesis: Advancing field dialogue automatically to the next decision point, and dropping the rest of an A batch once a conversation opens, removes the single-press dialogue turns (about half of Think Fast turns) and the A-batch re-trigger loops, so runs reach later milestones in fewer turns and less time.
notes: Operator 2026-10-15: "when we start to engage with any dialogue, it auto advances to the next decision point while recording all of the dialogue that was observed"; automatic; one switch covers auto-advance and the dialogue record (get_dialogue). Evidence: about 49% of Think Fast turns are a single A/B press through dialogue; finals run 2026-10-15T14-21-06_think-fast_6684 loops from turn 494 sending A x8 at the lab scientist; 2026-10-15T04-42-49_think-fast_0c40 turns 520-540 alternate A, B x7 at the lab aide. It acts at the first field message after the new game starts (Mom in the truck house). Part of the strong-bundle cohort (operator 2026-10-15). Provisional source.commit a85b591 (branch claude/r3-fixes, the parent of the round-3 fix commit; it contains this switch's implementation but not the round-3 fixes). It is repinned to the merge SHA on main with `just experiment-pin` when the bundle lands; until then this entry is not reproducible from main.
